t: r/AskACanadian on Reddit: What was Nortel? Why is it famous?
s: November 10, 2023 - The US side of Nortel was an expansion of the Canadian company, not a partnership or someone they got licensing from. One of the reasons why Nortel did so well in its last few decades was because the US telecom companies were no longer restricted to buying only in the US, and they started buying Nortel's products, because they were superior to what was available in the US.
